sn56.15:1.1: dhāretha no tumhe bhikkhave mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānīti.
sn56.15:1.2: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn56.15:1.3: ahaṃ kho bhante dhāremi bhagavatā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānīti.
sn56.15:1.4: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu dhāresi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānīti.
sn56.15:1.5: dukkhaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi
sn56.15:1.6: dukkhasamudayaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā dutiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi
sn56.15:1.7: dukkhanirodhaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā tatiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi
sn56.15:1.8: dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
sn56.15:1.9: evaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante dhāremi bhagavatā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānīti.
sn56.15:2.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu dhāresi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitāni.
sn56.15:2.3: dukkhaṃ kho bhikkhu mayā paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ tathā naṃ dhārehi
sn56.15:2.4: dukkhasamudayo kho bhikkhu mayā dutiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ tathā naṃ dhārehi
sn56.15:2.5: dukkhanirodho kho bhikkhu mayā tatiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ tathā naṃ dhārehi
sn56.15:2.6: dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā kho bhikkhu mayā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ tathā naṃ dhārehi.
sn56.15:2.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhu dhārehi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitāni. tasmā
sn56.15:3.1: tiha bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
